previous_entries.claim_zh: 同一历史的变化描述可在明确误差界内组合，并支持逐项条件判断；精确总量仍可能遗漏具体损失，组织变化可使旧描述失效。取得证据后的付费、耗时修订可改变实际回应，但校准与有限支持仍可使其失败，固定回应也可成功。同一时限下的查询／直接回应比较进一步以共同可行回应的交集识别有关区别，保留查询过晚与支持不足，并修订选择条件。变化依存下还须校准记录有效期；刷新后仍可能失效，后续变化界给出有条件的修复。 此前保留旧读数的留出检验保留最大变化界被突破及迁移失败；该轮所试区间均宽于控制器软目标带，完整经验认证尚未成立。 后续局部历史模型改善18项留出预测比较，胜过同容量跨通道模型；三个窄百分位区间仍有实际失败。
previous_entries.claim_en: Changing descriptions of one history compose under explicit error bounds and support indexed condition judgments; exact totals can still omit particular losses, and organizational change can defeat an earlier description. Acquired, paid and delayed revision can change the enacted response, while calibration and finite support can defeat it and a fixed response can also succeed. Common-horizon inquiry/immediate-response comparison identifies consequential distinctions through common admissible actions, retaining late inquiry and inadequate support and repairing the selection guard. Changed dependencies require calibrated temporal validity; a fresh reading can still fail, and bounded subsequent change supports a conditional repair. Earlier retained-reading tests retain maximum-envelope violations and transfer failures; every interval in that round exceeds the controller’s soft target width, leaving empirical certification incomplete. A subsequent local-history model improves 18 held-out comparisons and beats an equal-size coupled model; three narrow percentile intervals retain actual misses.
